text: CivicAction is an independent group that develops civic leadership to bring solutions and action to the challenges that face our communities. As the letter notes, Toronto has a history of collective leadership and incredible diversity that we are all very proud of. In an effort to recognize the importance of civic leadership in Toronto, CivicAction wishes to build an installation in David Pecaut Square. This installation will remind citizens that everyone has a role to play in building communities and the impact of collaborative leadership. The installation would pay tribute to the city-builders who have shaped this city and work to develop the next generation of civic leaders. CivicAction is seeking to secure approval from the City of Toronto for use of the square with a goal of having the installation designed and in place by spring 2018.
